The present application has been filed by the appellant seeking suspension of sentence during the pendency of the appeal.

2. By way of the present appeal, the appellant seeks to assail the judgement of conviction dated 16.05.2023 and order on sentence dated 01.09.2023 vide which the appellant was directed to undergo RI for a period of 6 years for the offence punishable under Section 10 of the POCSO Act with payment of fine of Rs.20,000/- and in default of payment of fine to undergo SI for 1 year.
The benefit of Section 428 Cr.P.C. has also been provided to the appellant.

sentences.text: 4. The application is opposed by the Learned APP for the State who is duly assisted by Mr. Harsh Prabkhakar, learned counsel appointed by DHCLSC to represent the victim.
5. I have heard the learned counsels for the parties and also gone through the statement of the child victim.
6. A perusal of the nominal roll of the appellant would show that appellant has undergone 2 years, 3 months and 21 days as on 07.04.2025.
It is also reflected that appellant was released on interim bail w.e.f. 01.03.2025 to 02.04.2025 which he has not misused the said concession and surrendered on time.

Keeping in view the totality of the facts and circumstances, the sentence of the appellant is directed to be suspended during the pendency of appeal on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court/Duty Judicial Magistrate/Link Judicial Magistrate/Jail Superintendent and also subject to the further following conditions:-
(i) In case of change of residential address, the appellant shall promptly inform the same to the concerned Investigating Officer as well as to this Court.
(ii) The appellant shall regularly appear before the Court as and when the appeal is taken up for hearing.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 04/09/2025 at 23:13:03 (iii) The appellant will not get in touch directly or indirectly with the victim.
(iv) The appellant shall also provider his contact number to the IO and shall remain available on that number.
7. With the above directions, the application is disposed of.
8. A copy of this order be communicated electronically forthwith to the concerned Jail Superintendent for information and necessary compliance.

1. Admit.
2. List in due course.
